engine: KiCad 9 bundled ngspice shared library, PSpice compatibility / XSPICE
model_limits: Generic LEVEL=1 MOS envelope: VTO=0.8/1.5/2.5V, KP=0.005 A/V^2, explicit body diode. No vendor temperature model.
PMOS envelope: VTO=-0.8/-1.5/-2.5V, KP=0.002 A/V^2. Off leakage is an injected 0/1uA scenario, not a guarantee.
External GPIO uses 0.25/0.75 of 3.3V as conservative digital thresholds; actual ESP pin specifications must be checked.
ML307 PWRKEY/RESET internal pull-up modeled as assumed 100k to VBAT / 1.8V. Actual internal values not supplied.
RC power model has ideal upstream supply. No switching control, cable inductance, RF, thermal or UPS path model.
MOS sweeps are parameter scenarios, not a temperature, production tolerance or lifetime qualification.

interfaces.scope: Static independent KiCad netlist / pin contract only. No UART timing or firmware execution.

unpowered_esp_envelope.limit: Injected 1uA hypothetical leak, generic diode; no real ESP protection/power sequencing model.

battery_adc.acceptance: 60ms settles within 0.1% of actual model steady state; reconstructed battery voltage within chosen 3% circuit-only target. ADC errors excluded.

external_power_detector.revision: R19=10k 1%, R20=100k 1%, Q5=Diodes 2N7002K-7; prior 100k/100k gate-threshold failure corrected in the generic envelope.
external_power_detector.action: Verify actual purchased part, temperature, slow ramps and insertion/removal; use a PGOOD/comparator for precise undervoltage detection.

boot_reset.limitations: 1ms RC does not remove multi-ms contact bounce. Firmware debounce and real dev-board EN parallel RC must be checked. No ESP boot-ROM simulation.

modem_control.limits: Internal pull-ups assumed. Model only checks MOS open-drain low / release. Actual boot, shutdown, recovery and RESET timing need module tests.

modem_power.cap_note: C6+C7+C8+C9+C10 = 494uF; previous 484uF illustration excluded C10. Bias/tolerance/temperature derating absent.
modem_power.design_review_issue: TI recommended output capacitor range is 20-68uF. Draft directly parallels ~494uF. Stability/startup/limit behavior not validated; cannot approve this buck BOM.
modem_power.reference: TPS563201 datasheet section 7.2.2.3 / ML307 hardware supply section 3.2.3
modem_power.limits: DC feedback calculation is not a regulated transient or thermal test. RC cases diagnose hypothetical paths, not actual board resistance.
